checkConstraints.definition: ([entity_type]='TASK' OR [entity_type]='REQUEST' OR [entity_type]='STOCK_DOCUMENT' OR [entity_type]='ASSET' OR [entity_type]='MAINTENANCE' OR [entity_type]='INCIDENT' OR [entity_type]='INSPECTION' OR [entity_type]='CLEANING_TASK' OR [entity_type]='ROOM')
([action]='LOGOUT' OR [action]='LOGIN' OR [action]='CANCEL' OR [action]='REJECT' OR [action]='APPROVE' OR [action]='DELETE' OR [action]='UPDATE' OR [action]='CREATE')
([to_status] IS NULL OR ([to_status]='CANCELLED' OR [to_status]='CLOSED' OR [to_status]='RESOLVED' OR [to_status]='IN_PROGRESS' OR [to_status]='OPEN'))
([status]='CANCELLED' OR [status]='REJECTED' OR [status]='CLOSED' OR [status]='COMPLETED' OR [status]='IN_PROGRESS' OR [status]='SUBMITTED' OR [status]='DRAFT')

([status]='CLOSED' AND [closed_at] IS NOT NULL AND [closed_by] IS NOT NULL AND len(ltrim(rtrim([close_reason])))>=(10) AND [close_reason] IS NOT NULL OR [status]<>'CLOSED' AND [closed_at] IS NULL AND [closed_by] IS NULL AND [close_reason] IS NULL)

([status]='COMPLETED' OR [status]='PARTIALLY_FULFILLED' OR [status]='RETURNED' OR [status]='SUBMITTED' OR [status]='CANCELLED' OR [status]='REJECTED' OR [status]='REMAINDER_CLOSED' OR [status]='FULLY_ISSUED' OR [status]='PARTIALLY_ISSUED' OR [status]='APPROVED' OR [status]='NEEDS_INFORMATION' OR [status]='PENDING_APPROVAL' OR [status]='DRAFT')
([new_status] IS NULL OR ([new_status]='CANCELLED' OR [new_status]='COMPLETED' OR [new_status]='BLOCKED' OR [new_status]='IN_PROGRESS' OR [new_status]='TODO'))
([old_status] IS NULL OR ([old_status]='CANCELLED' OR [old_status]='COMPLETED' OR [old_status]='BLOCKED' OR [old_status]='IN_PROGRESS' OR [old_status]='TODO'))
([source_type] IS NULL OR ([source_type]='MANUAL' OR [source_type]='INTERNAL_REQUEST' OR [source_type]='MAINTENANCE' OR [source_type]='INSPECTION' OR [source_type]='CLEANING'))
([status]='COMPLETED' AND [result] IS NOT NULL OR [status]<>'COMPLETED' AND [result] IS NULL)

([from_status] IS NULL OR ([from_status]='OUT_OF_SERVICE' OR [from_status]='READY' OR [from_status]='INSPECTION' OR [from_status]='CLEANING' OR [from_status]='DIRTY' OR [from_status]='OCCUPIED' OR [from_status]='AVAILABLE'))
([to_status]='OUT_OF_SERVICE' OR [to_status]='READY' OR [to_status]='INSPECTION' OR [to_status]='CLEANING' OR [to_status]='DIRTY' OR [to_status]='OCCUPIED' OR [to_status]='AVAILABLE')

([trigger_type] IS NULL OR ([trigger_type]='MANUAL_CORRECTION' OR [trigger_type]='MAINTENANCE' OR [trigger_type]='ROOM_BLOCK' OR [trigger_type]='INSPECTION' OR [trigger_type]='CLEANING_TASK' OR [trigger_type]='CHECKOUT' OR [trigger_type]='CHECKIN' OR [trigger_type]='RELEASE' OR [trigger_type]='INIT'))
